title: Sing with All Your Heart
traveler_why: Scout is the Seeker who loves to share what he finds, and tonight’s psalm says sing a joyful song: on a bright, sunny morning a thank-you song bubbles right out of Scout, and soon the whole family is singing along.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves to share joyful praise. In Scout’s world today: Scout woke up to a bright, sunny morning and felt so happy that a little song just bubbled right out. Scout marched around singing, “Thank you, Heavenly Father, for this beautiful day!” and soon the whole family was singing along. Just like the psalm invites us to sing joyfully, Scout discovered that praising Heavenly Father makes joy spread everywhere.
